ui.providers.stored_key.replace.length: Two short words; English is 11 characters.
ui.providers.stored_key.replace.note: Saves the pasted API key over the one already stored for this provider. Shown instead of 'Save key' when a key is already stored.

ui.providers.stored_key.remove.length: Two short words; English is 10 characters.
ui.providers.stored_key.remove.note: Starts removing the stored API key for this provider; a confirmation follows.

ui.providers.stored_key.remove_confirm.note: Asked after 'Remove key' is pressed, before anything is deleted.

ui.providers.stored_key.remove_failed.role: Inline error under the key field
ui.providers.stored_key.remove_failed.note: Fallback when the daemon refused to remove the key and sent no sentence of its own.
